articles.title: Longfellow Sells Hatch Life Sciences Building in LIC for $87M
articles.narrative: Longfellow Real Estate Partners, in partnership with Sculptor Real Estate, has sold its Hatch Life Sciences Building in Long Island City, Queens, for $86.9 million to an entity associated with Pearl Realty Management. This transaction marks a discount from the $92.5 million Longfellow and Sculptor paid for the property in 2021, where they had planned a $120 million conversion of the former manufacturing plant into a life sciences and office facility. The sale concludes Longfellow's first project in New York City.

data_points.notable_features: Former parachute manufacturing plant converted into a mix of life sciences labs and offices, including prebuilt lab suites, modular research space, and flexible office areas.
data_points.project_notes: The property was previously acquired in 2021 for $92.5 million by Longfellow and Sculptor Real Estate, with plans for an additional $120 million investment in conversion.

articles.title: Barry Sternlicht’s Starwood Buys Two Miami Affordable Housing Rentals
articles.narrative: Starwood Asset Management, led by Barry Sternlicht, has acquired two affordable housing properties in Miami-Dade County from the Gatehouse Group for a combined $63.8 million. The portfolio includes the 150-unit Magnolia Landing Apartments in Naranja and the 160-unit Lafayette Square complex in Little River. This acquisition highlights continued investor interest in the affordable housing sector within the Miami market.

data_points.address: 25881 Southwest 143rd Court, Miami, FL / 150 Northeast 79th Street, Miami, FL
data_points.notable_features: Magnolia Landing Apartments consists of 20 three-story buildings; Lafayette Square is a 19-story building.
data_points.project_notes: The Gatehouse Group developed both properties, completing Lafayette Square in 2008 and Magnolia Landing in 2011. The seller appears to have retained ownership of an adjacent 136-unit property next to Lafayette Square.

articles.title: Ad Agency Doubles Office HQ Space in Move to Hackman Campus in L.A.
articles.narrative: An international advertising agency, Innocean USA, has signed a new headquarters lease for 101,000 square feet at Hackman Capital Partners' creative office campus in El Segundo, CA. The agency will relocate nearly 600 employees from its current 50,000-square-foot space in Huntington Beach once construction on the new facility is completed in 2027. The move represents a significant expansion and investment in creating an optimal environment for the company's future growth, with part of the space reportedly designated for commercial production.

data_points.notable_features: Creative office campus converted from a former aerospace manufacturing complex.
data_points.project_notes: Hackman Capital Partners acquired the former Northrop Grumman complex in 2016 and invested approximately $100 million in its conversion.

articles.title: Attorney James Allen Joins Camber Property Group as Senior Counsel
articles.narrative: James Allen has joined Camber Property Group as Senior Counsel, where he will focus on affordable housing and community development transactions across New York state and the tri-state region. Allen brings experience from his previous roles at Hirschen Singer & Epstein and Nixon Peabody, and will assist Camber in navigating the complexities of expanding both project types and geographic footprint in response to the ongoing housing affordability crisis.

articles.title: Selldorf Architects Renews 14K-SF 860 Broadway Lease for 10 Years
articles.narrative: Selldorf Architects has renewed its 13,815-square-foot office lease at 860 Broadway in Manhattan's Flatiron District for another 10 years. The architecture firm has occupied space in the building for two decades, a testament to the property's enduring appeal and the strength of the Midtown South market, according to the landlord's broker. The landlord emphasized their long-term ownership strategy and commitment to creating an environment where companies choose to remain and expand.

data_points.notable_features: Six-story commercial office building with ground-floor retail space, located at the intersection of the Flatiron and Union Square neighborhoods.

articles.market_intelligence: Average asking rent for office space in Midtown South was $79.41 per square foot during Q2, with Class A office space at $97.22/SF and Class B at $79.96/SF.

articles.title: Franklin Street Negotiates Sale of 138-Unit Multifamily Property in Southwest Fort Worth
articles.narrative: Franklin Street has brokered the sale of The Reserve on Willow Lake, a 138-unit multifamily property in southwest Fort Worth. The 1996-built community offers a mix of two- and three-bedroom apartments and townhomes, complemented by amenities such as a pool, fitness center, and business center. The Paskin Group sold the asset to Willowood Group.

data_points.address: 4101 S Hulen St, Fort Worth, TX
data_points.notable_features: Amenities include a pool, fitness center, and business center.

articles.title: Adolfson & Peterson Completes Renovation of Residence Hall at University of Texas San Antonio
articles.narrative: Adolfson & Peterson Construction has completed the renovation of Chisholm Hall, a 120,860-square-foot residence hall on the University of Texas at San Antonio campus. The project involved modernizing building systems, upgrading bathroom vanity areas, and installing new acoustical ceilings, lighting, mechanical unit ventilators, and hallway ductwork across 267 rooms. The hall offers double and triple-occupancy rooms.

data_points.notable_features: Features two fully furnished layout options, including double- and triple-occupancy rooms.

companies_people.label: OWNER
companies_people.firm_name: University of Texas at San Antonio

articles.title: MMCC Arranges $8.2M Loan for Refinancing of Self-Storage Facility in DeSoto, Texas
articles.narrative: Marcus & Millichap Capital Corp. (MMCC) has facilitated an $8.2 million refinancing loan for Grizzly Self Storage, a self-storage facility located in DeSoto, Texas. The 10-year loan was arranged by Doug Brooks of MMCC for an undisclosed borrower, with the direct lender also remaining unnamed.

data_points.notable_features: Offers both personal and commercial storage spaces.

articles.title: Marcus & Millichap Brokers Sale of 12,000 SF Industrial Building in Midland, Texas
articles.narrative: Marcus & Millichap has brokered the sale of a 12,000-square-foot industrial building in Midland, Texas. The single-tenant property, built in 2019 on 6.6 acres, was fully leased at the time of sale. The undisclosed buyer acquired the asset through a 1031 exchange.

data_points.project_notes: Buyer acquired the building via a 1031 exchange.

articles.title: JLL Arranges Recapitalization of Downtown Pittsburgh Mixed-Use Property
articles.narrative: JLL has arranged the recapitalization of Tower Two-Sixty, a mixed-use property in downtown Pittsburgh, valued at $69 million. The transaction involved a ground-lease bifurcation sale of the land to Woodbranch Investments Corp. and leasehold financing provided by Dollar Bank. The property, completed in 2016, includes office, retail, a hotel, and a parking garage.

data_points.address: Pittsburgh Plate Glass Bldg, 260 Forbes Ave, Pittsburgh, PA
data_points.notable_features: Includes 130,000 square feet of office, 14,000 square feet of retail, a 197-key Hilton-branded hotel, and a 321-space parking garage.
data_points.project_notes: Recapitalization entailed a ground-lease bifurcation sale of the land and financing of the leasehold improvements.

articles.title: Colliers adds SVP in Grand Rapids office
articles.narrative: Colliers has announced the return of Matt Abraham as Senior Vice President to its Grand Rapids, Michigan, office. Abraham brings over two decades of commercial real estate experience, specializing in industrial and investment properties, and previously spent 13 years with Colliers serving clients in West Michigan.

articles.title: Gerdom Realty and Investment closes 12,058-square-foot lease in Commerce Township
articles.narrative: Gerdom Realty and Investment has successfully brokered a lease agreement for a 12,058-square-foot commercial space in Commerce Township, Michigan. The transaction involved A1 Garage securing the space, with Gerdom Realty and Investment representing the landlord and CBRE representing the tenant. Gerdom Realty and Investment will also manage the property.

articles.title: Boyko Properties buys 13,313-square-foot industrial building in Menomonee Falls
articles.narrative: Boyko Properties has acquired a 13,313-square-foot industrial building in Menomonee Falls, Wisconsin, from B&E Pattern Co. The property, situated on 1.59 acres, will be partially owner-occupied by A.O. Handy, a masonry repair and restoration contractor, which plans to relocate its operations to the new facility.

articles.title: Lawrence Group providing architecture services for health and manufacturing building in Rolla
articles.narrative: Lawrence Group is providing architecture, interior design, and planning services for East Central College's new $11 million Allied Health and Advanced Manufacturing Building in Rolla, Missouri. The 107,000-square-foot renovation project will consolidate the college's academic programs, student services, and advanced manufacturing center into a single facility. This integration aims to enhance operational efficiency by eliminating the need for the college to lease two separate off-site locations, while also strengthening campus identity and fostering collaborative learning environments.

data_points.property_name: Allied Health and Advanced Manufacturing Building
data_points.notable_features: Consolidates academic programs, student services, and an advanced manufacturing center into a single facility; designed to foster hands-on learning and interdisciplinary collaboration.
data_points.project_notes: The renovated facility previously housed United States Geological Survey operations. East Central College will vacate two currently leased spaces at Rolla Technical Center and 2303 North Bishop Road upon completion.

articles.title: Selldorf Architects Signs Long-Term Renewal at 860 Broadway
articles.narrative: Selldorf Architects has renewed its 13,815-square-foot office lease at 860 Broadway for another 10 years. The architecture firm has been a tenant in the building for two decades, and its decision to recommit to the property underscores the enduring appeal of the iconic Manhattan office building and the long-term strength of the market, according to the landlord's broker.

data_points.project_notes: Selldorf Architects has occupied the building for the past two decades.

articles.title: Innocean USA Signs 100K-SF lease with Hackman Capital in Headquarters Relocation
articles.narrative: Advertising agency Innocean USA has signed a 101,000-square-foot office lease at Hackman Capital Partners' 888 N. Douglas property in El Segundo, marking a significant headquarters relocation and expansion from its previous 50,000-square-foot space in Huntington Beach. The move, anticipated for 2027 upon construction completion, is described by the tenant's broker as a transformative change designed to foster creativity and employee thriving in a unique facility.

data_points.notable_features: 30-acre campus with four buildings totaling approximately 550,000 square feet, located across from the Lakers' practice facility and the L.A. Times headquarters.
data_points.project_notes: Hackman Capital Partners acquired the 1930s-era aerospace manufacturing site in 2016 and invested $100 million to redevelop it into a creative office campus.

articles.title: MADDD Equities Scoops Up Vacant West Farms Industrial
articles.narrative: MADDD Equities has acquired a vacant 60,000-square-foot multi-story industrial property at 425 Devoe Ave. in the West Farms neighborhood of The Bronx for $10.75 million. The property, which also includes 30,000 square feet below grade, was sold by Abingdon Square Partners. The sale highlights the robust demand for large commercial sites with excellent regional transportation access.

data_points.address: 425 Devoe Ave, New York City, NY
data_points.notable_features: Features four levels of usable industrial and warehouse space, located near 2 and 5 subway lines, and offers convenient access to the Cross Bronx Expressway and Sheridan Boulevard.

articles.title: Shopoff Secures Approval for Buena Park Residential Development
articles.narrative: Shopoff Realty Investments has received unanimous approval from the Buena Park City Council for a 13.76-acre residential development at 5600 Beach Blvd. The project will transform an industrial site, currently occupied by Amway Corporation under a sale-leaseback agreement until late 2026, into a mixed-housing community. The developer emphasized the project's role in addressing the need for attainable and diverse housing options for first-time homebuyers and the senior population in Buena Park.

data_points.notable_features: The development will include 231 three-story townhomes and duplex units, and 50 for-rent senior affordable housing units.
data_points.project_notes: The site is currently occupied by Amway Corporation with a corporate sale-leaseback in place until the end of 2026. Homes are expected to be delivered in 2029-2030.

articles.title: Matawan Retail Trades to Private Investor for $15M
articles.narrative: Park Plaza, a 61,750-square-foot retail center in Matawan, NJ, has been sold for $14.67 million to a private investor. The property, which features a diverse tenant mix and strong visibility, attracted significant investor interest due to its strategic location in a well-established retail corridor. This transaction highlights the sustained demand for quality neighborhood shopping centers with durable cash flow in the New Jersey market.

data_points.notable_features: Features a diverse mix of dining, lifestyle, retail, and service-oriented tenants, including a Dunkin' with a drive-thru.

articles.title: Detailed Design Plans Revealed For Women's Soccer Stadium: The Denver Deal Sheet
articles.narrative: Detailed design plans have been revealed for the new women's soccer stadium for Denver Summit FC, which is slated to open in 2028.

articles.title: Amazon Renews 300K SF Office Lease In Downtown San Francisco
articles.narrative: Amazon has renewed its 300,000-square-foot office lease at 525 Market Street in downtown San Francisco. This renewal signals the company's continued commitment to the city and its plans for further expansion in both office and robotics facilities within the San Francisco market.

articles.title: Wall Street Anxiety Pushes Meta Into The Neocloud Business
articles.narrative: Meta Platforms, facing investor pressure regarding its substantial AI investments, is reportedly exploring a strategy to monetize its excess computing capacity. The company plans to offer its infrastructure to other artificial intelligence firms, aiming to generate short-term revenue and alleviate Wall Street's concerns about its spending. This move represents a strategic pivot to leverage existing assets for new income streams.

articles.title: Developer To Replace Coworking Space With Industrial: The Houston Deal Sheet
articles.narrative: Stotan Industrial is developing a new 345,000-square-foot industrial facility in Houston. This project is part of a broader trend in the Houston real estate market, which also saw the sale of a grocery store portfolio this week.

data_points.project_notes: The project replaces a former coworking space.

articles.title: Comcast Consolidates To 140K SF In Times Square
articles.narrative: Comcast has consolidated its ad sales and tech arm into a 140,000-square-foot space at 1540 Broadway in Times Square. This move represents a strategic consolidation for the company within a prominent New York City location.
